Arkansas National Guard Wildfire Response Update
Operations are fully underway near Camden, Arkansas.

D6 and D7 Dozers and operators work with local agencies to prevent further spread of the Bunker Fire in Camden Arkansas by creating a break to “cut off” the fire’s path and protect areas behind it.

Staff Sgt. Christian Clark, and Maj. Clark Eppler speak on behalf of the Installation Support Unit (ISU) and their operations on the ground. Sept 16, 2026.

items.description: Marine Corps Air Station Miramar and Shepherdess Land and Livestock released over 400 goats to East Miramar as part of Operation Goat Rope at MCAS Miramar, California, Sep. 15, 2026.
